title: Broncos have excused OLB Jonathon Cooper from this weeks minicamp practices

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Broncos have excused OLB Jonathon Cooper from this weeks minicamp practices
sources.description: It was reported earlier today that the Denver Broncos have excused outside linebacker Jonathon Cooper from this week’s mandatory minicamp practices after being arrested for the second time last week. After today’s practice, head coach Sean Payton met with the media and confirmed as much, and had a much different tone on the matter than […]
